options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: bearer_token
options.description: Authentication bearer token. Needed when doing an ADM service proxy call.

options.name: bundle
options.description: Parse the certificate chain as a single file after linking the server certificate to its issuer's within the file.

options.name: cert
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the X509 certificate file that is used to form the certificate-key The certificate file should be present on the appliance's hard-disk drive or solid-state drive. a certificate in any location other than the default might cause inconsistency in a high availability /nsconfig/ssl/ is the default path. Minimum length =  1

options.name: certkey
options.description: Name for the certificate and private-key pair. Must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric or underscore character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon at (@), equals (=), and hyphen (-) characters. Cannot be changed after the certificate-key pair is The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for "my cert" or 'my cert'). Minimum length =

options.name: deletefromdevice
options.description: Delete cert/key file from file system.

options.name: expirymonitor
options.description: Issue an alert when the certificate is about to expire.

options.name: fipskey
options.description: Name of the FIPS key that was created inside the Hardware Security Module (HSM) of a FIPS appliance, a key that was imported into the HSM. Minimum length =  1

options.name: hsmkey
options.description: Name of the HSM key that was created in the External Hardware Security Module (HSM) of a FIPS Minimum length =  1

options.name: inform
options.description: Input format of the certificate and the private-key files. The three formats supported by the are: PEM - Privacy Enhanced Mail DER - Distinguished Encoding Rule PFX - Personal Information Exchange.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: The id of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: instance_ip
options.description: The target Citrix ADC instance ip address to which all underlying NITRO API calls will be proxied to. It is meaningful only when having set C(mas_proxy_call) to C(true)

options.name: instance_name
options.description: The name of the target Citrix ADC instance when issuing a Nitro request through a Citrix ADM proxy.

options.name: is_cloud
options.description: When performing a Proxy API call with ADM service set this to C(true)

options.name: key
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the private-key file that is used to form the certificate-key pair. certificate file should be present on the appliance's hard-disk drive or solid-state drive. Storing a in any location other than the default might cause inconsistency in a high availability setup. is the default path. Minimum length =  1

options.name: linkcertkeyname
options.description: Name of the Certificate Authority certificate-key pair to which to link a certificate-key pair. Minimum length =  1

options.name: mas_proxy_call
options.description: If true the underlying NITRO API calls made by the module will be proxied through a Citrix ADM node to the target Citrix ADC instance. When true you must also define the following options: I(nitro_auth_token) When true and adm service is the api proxy the following option must also be defined: I(bearer_token) When true you must define a target ADC by defining any of the following parameters I(instance_ip) I(instance_id) I(instance_name)

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds until a timeout error is thrown when establishing a new session with Citrix ADC

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: nodomaincheck
options.description: Override the check for matching domain names during a certificate update operation.

options.name: notificationperiod
options.description: Time, in number of days, before certificate expiration, at which to generate an alert that the is about to expire. Minimum value = C(10) Maximum value = C(100)

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the Citrix ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: ocspstaplingcache
options.description: Clear cached ocspStapling response in certkey.

options.name: passplain
options.description: Pass phrase used to encrypt the private-key. Required when adding an encrypted private-key in PEM Minimum length =  1

options.name: password
options.description: Passphrase that was used to encrypt the private-key. Use this option to load encrypted private-keys PEM format.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If true the module will save the configuration on the Citrix ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the Citrix ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the Citrix ADC node. When present the resource will be created if needed and configured according to the module's parameters. When absent the resource will be deleted from the Citrix ADC node.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
